name: 权限授权
description: 第一方基础设施插件：解析插件 manifest.permissions，安装/启用时展示权限清单并请求用户授权（approval policy）
author: Is Sheep Box

services.name: approval-policy
services.description: 授权判定服务：解析权限声明、请求用户授权、运行时权限校验

events.name: approval:requested
events.description: 安装/启用流程请求授权时发布；载荷 { pluginId, pluginName, permissions, source? }

events.name: approval:granted
events.description: 用户授权通过时发布；载荷 { pluginId, permissions, auto? }

events.name: approval:denied
events.description: 用户拒绝时发布；载荷 { pluginId, permissions, reason? }
